storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Sci-Fi Story
storyTemplate.description: A spaceport sci-fi start: arrive on an orbital station and claim a work contract before your docking window expires.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The shuttle hatch opens onto recycled air, bright dock lights, and the low thunder of engines bleeding through the station hull.

Your temporary pass blinks amber on your wrist: visitor access, two hours remaining. Across the gantry, a public contract terminal cycles through salvage jobs, courier runs, and station security postings.

Before the timer locks you out of the work decks, you need a contract with your name on it.
